content.tagline: Professional aesthetics: not an hour of hydration, but a rebuilt skin structure
content.descriptor: Korean professional skincare brand for aesthetic rooms; formulas built on wild soybean water, exosomes and PDRN
about: DOOBOM Co., Ltd. is a Korean professional skincare brand that grew out of treatment rooms rather than marketing. The company collects data from partner salons — what clients actually come in with and what visibly works during a treatment — and builds its formulas from that. It describes itself as an R&D-led brand where ingredients, delivery technology and proven results come first.

The difference starts at the base of the formula. Instead of purified water, Doobom uses an extract of Korean wild soybean. That base carries its own actives, so the product starts working from a useful foundation rather than from a carrier. The stated goal is not short-term hydration or a momentary firming effect, but work on the structure of the skin — from the barrier down to deeper layers.

The active side rests on four groups: ginseng-derived exosomes and PDRN for recovery and radiance; patented natural spicules, highly refined, whose fine channel structure carries actives deeper; a fast-acting peptide for collagen, elastin and softer expression lines; and a brightening complex — caffeine, vitamin K, niacinamide, vitamin C and derivatives, arbutin, hyaluronic acid. Products are assembled into ready salon programmes rather than sold as a set of unrelated jars.
facts: The brand comes from professional aesthetics: formulas are built on data from partner treatment rooms
Formula base is an extract of Korean wild soybean instead of purified water
Ginseng-derived exosomes and PDRN — recovery, radiance, work around the eye area
Patented, highly refined natural spicules: a channel structure that improves penetration of actives
Fast-acting peptide for collagen and elastin; brightening complex on niacinamide, arbutin and vitamin C
channels: Aesthetic salons, treatment rooms and spas

lines.name: Ampoule & Booster
lines.note: Ampoule concentrates for the treatment itself and for continuing the course at home, including a niacinamide booster for sebum, pores and skin texture.

lines.name: Exosome & PDRN
lines.note: The recovery line: exosomes derived from ginseng, plus PDRN. The aim is to bring back the skin's own activity, lift radiance and work on the eye area.

lines.name: Spicule MTS
lines.note: Products with highly refined natural spicules. Their micro-channel structure raises the skin's permeability to actives — the technique aestheticians know from MTS treatments.

lines.name: Salon Programs
lines.note: Ready in-room protocols: a sequence of products for a specific client concern rather than separate items. Assembled from partner salon data.

tech.name: Development from field data
tech.note: The brand works with professional salons and collects real statistics on client concerns and outcomes. A formula appears as the answer to a problem the room keeps meeting.

tech.name: Wild soybean base instead of water
tech.note: Formulas are based on an extract of Korean wild soybean, so the base itself carries active substances rather than acting only as a solvent.

tech.name: Delivery through spicules
tech.note: Natural spicules go through multi-stage refining and work as a delivery system: a fine channel structure carries actives deeper than plain application would.

tech.name: Ingredient base
tech.note: Ginseng exosomes, PDRN, fast-acting peptides, niacinamide, arbutin, vitamins C and K, caffeine, hyaluronic acid.
